project.title: The effect of metformin on the neural differentiation of gingival mesenchymal stem cells in three-dimensional culture
project.projectDescription: Proteomics was used to explore the effect of metformin on the neural differentiation of gingival mesenchymal stem cells in three-dimensional culture.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: GMSCs were added with 8M urea (Xilong Scientific, China) in 100 mM TEAB (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA) and lysed in ice for 30 min. After centrifugation at 12000 rpm for 10min, the supernatant was transferred and stored. 300 μg protein was extracted and mixed with DL-dithiothreitol (DTT, Macklin, China) and indole-3-acetic acid (IAA, Macklin, China) in trypsin at 37℃ overnights to prepare polypeptides. The mixture was desalted at Sep-Pak C18 1cc Vac Cartridge (Waters, USA). The peptide was labeled at room temperature with a Tandem Mass Tag (TMT, Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA) for 1 h and terminated at 5% hydroxylamine (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA). GMSCs cells from the same group were taken for 3 times of repeat experiment. After drying, the peptide was redissolved in 1% formic acid (FA, Rhawn, China) and detected by mass spectrometry. The mobile phases carrying polypeptides are redistributed in the C18-reversed-phase, Torrance, CA Gemini columns. The eluent was identified based on Orbitrap Fusion MS (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and is equipped with an online Easy-NLC 1000 system (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
project.dataProcessingProtocol: The original file from MS/MS was read in Maxquant software (version 1.6.2.0) based on the human FASTA database of Uniprot (https://www.uniprot.org/). The false discovery rate (FDR) was limited to 0.01 by using the integrated tool.
